name: FSP Technology Inc.
summary: FSP Technology Inc. engages in manufacture, process, and trade of power supplies and electronic components in Taiwan, China, the United States of America, Germany, and internationally. The company's products include adapter; industrial PC, open frame, immersion cooling, medical, panel mount, television, solid-state lighting, and personal computer power supply; battery charger; PV inverter; uninterruptible power system; energy storage system; and display PSU. It also offers PSU plus BBU, and CRPS and M-CRPS.
